abstract: A bipedal robot has an upper body 1 which comprises a higher upper body 5 and a lower upper body 6. The higher upper body 5 and the lower upper body 6 are coupled to each other by a rotating mechanism 13 so as to be rotatable with respect to each other about a vertical axis C of rotation. Two legs 2 extend from the lower upper body 6, and two arms 3 extend from respective shoulders 14 on opposite sides of the higher upper body 5. The higher upper body 5 of the robot has a thickness D in a forward/rearward direction and the lower upper body 6 has a width Wd in a lateral direction, the thickness D and the width Wd being smaller than the width Wu in a lateral direction of the robot at shoulders 14 (shoulder width Wu). An electric energy storage device 8 as a power supply for operating the robot is mounted in the higher upper body 5, and an electronic circuit unit 11 for controlling operation of the robot is mounted in the lower upper body 6. With this robot arrangement, the robot is capable of increasing its working capability without impairing the stability of the attitude when the robot works. <IMAGE>
source_title: BIPEDAL ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a mechanical structure of a three-dimensional human-simulate biped walking robot. The mechanical structure comprises a trunk, two hip joints arranged in symmetry, an angle bisection mechanism, an arm-thigh coupling mechanism, and leg mechanisms arranged in symmetry in sequence from top to bottom, wherein the leg mechanism at each side comprises a thigh, a knee joint, a shank, an ankle joint, and a vola in sequence from top to bottom, and the trunk is provided with a master control chip. According to the mechanical structure, based on related principle of passive mechanics, the human-simulation degree is high, the problems of low energy efficiency and stiff gait of the conventional robot are effectively solved, the robot can serve as exoskeleton to help the disabled to realize walking and serve as walking equipment in future wars, and the individual combat ability is improved. The invention also discloses a waking method for the mechanical structure of the three-dimensional human-simulated biped walking robot.
source_title: Mechanical structure of three-dimensional human-simulated biped walking robot and walking method

abstract: The present invention is to provide a biped robot-type toy driven by a brush-type direct current (DC) motor to reduce manufacturing cost. According to the present invention, the biped robot-type toy comprises: a lower body portion having a first leg module and a second leg module on both sides thereof; an upper body portion corresponding to the upper body of the biped robot-type toy and having a first arm module and a second arm module on both sides thereof; and a center of gravity moving portion disposed at a position connecting the upper body portion and the lower body portion for walking operation, and moving the center of gravity of the biped robot-type toy toward the first leg module or the second leg module by adjusting the position of the upper body portion before driving the first leg module or the second leg module.
source_title: BIPED ROBOT TPYE TOY

abstract: The flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot comprises a head, a trunk, arms and legs, and the core structure of the flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot is a balance movement mechanism composed of the trunk and the legs. The trunk comprises a sliding rail, a flywheel shell, a motor, a ball screw, a storage battery, a power electronic conversion device, a stepping motor, a coupler, a fastening connecting piece, a shock pad, an upper rolling bearing, a rotating shaft, a magnetic induction coil, a flywheel and a lower rolling bearing. The legs comprise hip joints, knee joints and ankle joints, all the mechanisms operate in a coordinated mode to achieve overall operation of the flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot, and the flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot comprises a flywheel energy storage structure, a gravity center adjusting structure, a leg movement structure and a balance control structure. The stability is improved; by utilizing the flywheel energy storage principle, mechanical energy is converted into electric energy and stored, so that continuous advancing power is provided; and each leg has four degrees of freedom, so that the mechanical complexity is reduced.
source_title: Flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a motion balancing device of a biped walking robot. The device comprises mechanical feet, mechanical legs are arranged at the tops of the mechanical feet, a manipulator is arranged at the tops of the mechanical legs, bodies are arranged at the two sides of the manipulator, and a head is arranged at the top of the manipulator. Each mechanical foot comprises a foot plate, anda buckle is inserted into the center of the bottom of each foot plate. According to the scheme, sensors can be placed in inner cavities of placing grooves, one ends with cables penetrate through cable grooves, buckles are buckled in inner cavities of buckle grooves, meanwhile, abut-joint blocks are buckled in inner cavities of abut-joint grooves, the sensors can be buckled in inner cavities of the foot plates, pulling blocks are pulled towards the two sides, clamping blocks at the inner sides of the pulling blocks can be brought out of clamping grooves, and therefore clamping mechanisms are taken out. The mounting and dismounting process is simple and convenient, mounting and dismounting can be completed without screwing or unscrewing screws, and the mounting and dismounting efficiency isgreatly improved.
source_title: Motion balancing device of biped walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot based on electro-hydraulic servo drive and an advancing method thereof, the robot comprises a trunk, upper limbs with motor drive joints and lower limbs with hydraulic drive joints, and the lower limbs are composed of leg assemblies and foot assemblies. The upper limb, double arms and the dexterous hand part use electric mechanical arms to complete specified actions, high flexibility is achieved, the lower limb part is driven by a high-power-density hydraulic oil source, strong explosive force and support can be provided for movement of the whole robot, and the lower limb of the robot obtains stronger power and meanwhile can be driven by the hydraulic oil source. Under the load that the upper limbs are heavy, stronger supporting force and pressure resistance are provided, due to the fact that electro-hydraulic cooperative driving is adopted, overall performance optimization is achieved according to different component requirements, more efficient and more flexible robot design is achieved, and the overall movement ability of the robot is enhanced while the overall performance and adaptability are improved.
source_title: Biped robot based on electro-hydraulic servo drive and advancing method thereof

abstract: The invention provides a biped robot capable of being automatically spliced, a multi-configuration robot and a control method of the multi-configuration robot. The biped robot comprises a trunk, arms, legs, tolerance butt joint sleeves and a trunk butt joint device. Arms are correspondingly arranged on the left and right sides of the trunk, and two legs are arranged on the lower side of the trunk; the tolerance butt joint sleeve is movably arranged on the rear side of the trunk through a base, and the trunk butt joint device is fixed to the front side of the trunk. Biped robot single bodies can form a multi-configuration foot type combination body in a self-organization and reconstruction mode, multi-foot configuration states such as biped, four-foot and six-foot are achieved, the movement stability and the load capacity of the foot type robot are improved in a foot type modular splicing combination mode, and movement and operation such as strong complex terrain movement and cooperative carrying are achieved.
source_title: Biped robot capable of being autonomously spliced, multi-configuration robot and control method thereof

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a three-motor companion robot. The three-motor companion robot comprises a robot body, a head device, foot devices and hand devices, wherein the head device, the foot devices and the hand devices are arranged on the robot body. Each foot device comprises a shell, a power supply structure which is arranged inside the shell, a first driving structure which is arranged inside the shell and connected with the power supply structure, and a first obstacle avoidance structure which is arranged inside the shell. The robot body is internally provided with a second driving structure which is connected with the first driving structures and the head device. The robot is provided with three motors, the motors can be awakened through body induction, and the two feet and the head are controlled to move. The feet are provided with the obstacle avoidance structures, and therefore the three-motor companion robot achieves better obstacle avoidance capacity.
source_title: Three-motor companion robot

abstract: The invention provides a foot type robot and a control method of the foot type robot. The foot type robot comprises a trunk assembly, a storage bin, foot assemblies and mechanical arms. The storage bin is fixedly connected with the trunk assembly, and the storage bin is provided with a storage space which can be used for placing articles; the foot assembly is movably connected with the trunk assembly, the foot assembly comprises at least two feet arranged at intervals, and the at least two feet move so that the foot type robot can move; and the mechanical arm and the storage bin are arranged on the trunk assembly in a spaced mode, and the mechanical arm can move relative to the storage bin so as to move the objects out of the storage bin or put the objects into the storage bin. The function of conveying the articles is achieved through the foot type robot, the articles can enter and exit from the storage bin through the mechanical arm, and the convenience of article conveying can be improved.
source_title: Foot type robot and control method of foot type robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a biped robotic toy comprising: a lower body part having a first leg module and a second leg module on both sides; an upper body part corresponding to an upper body of the biped robotic and having a first arm module and a second arm module at both sides; and a center of gravity moving part disposed at a position connecting the upper body and the lower body for walking motion, and moving a center of gravity of the biped robotic toy toward the first leg module or the second leg module side by adjusting the position of upper body part prior to driving the first leg module or the second leg module.
source_title: BIPED ROBOT TPYE TOY

abstract: The walking robot is a mobile robot. The walking robot moves in a bipedal manner. The bipedal movement of the walking robot is autonomous. The walking robot is a programmed device that: 1) can move in a bipedal fashion; 2) pick up and put down objects; 3) performs optical data processing functions such as avoiding objects during motion or identifying objects to pick up and put down; 4) performs speech recognition functions such as receiving spoken instruction; and, 5) responds to spoken instruction in an audible manner using a spoken language. The walking robot comprises a torso, a plurality of legs, a plurality of arms, and a helmet. The plurality of legs, the plurality of arms, and the helmet is attached to the torso. Both the plurality of legs and plurality of arms both rotate in the coronal plane, sagittal plane and the transverse plane.
source_title: Walking robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot door opening method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: determining a first movement radius of a hand of the robot around a door spindle, a second movement radius of a waist of the robot around the door spindle, and a body orientation adjustment angle required by a connecting line of centers of two feet of the robot to pass through the door spindle; determining a hand planning track and a waist planning track of the robot according to the first movement radius, the second movement radius and a preset door opening angle; and controlling the robot to perform door opening operation according to the hand planning track and the waist planning track. By means of the method, the hand track and the waist track of the robot can be planned at the same time according to the motion radius, the robot is controlled to conduct door opening operation according to the obtained hand planning track and the waist planning track, the motion coordination of the robot is improved, and accurate control over whole-body motion of the robot is achieved.
source_title: Robot door opening method and device, readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a biped robotic toy and a control method thereof. Provided is a biped robotic toy comprising: a lower body part having a first leg module and a second leg module on both sides; an upper body part corresponding to an upper body of the biped robotic and having a first arm module and a second arm module at both sides; and a center-of-gravity moving part disposed at a position connecting the upper body and the lower body for walking motion, and moving a center of gravity of the biped robotic toy toward the first leg module or the second leg module side by adjusting the position of upper body part prior to driving the first leg module or the second leg module. In addition, provided is a control method of the biped robotic toy comprising the steps of: moving a position of an upper body part toward the first leg module; advancing the second leg module; moving the position of the upper body part toward the second leg module; and backward driving the second leg module.
source_title: CONTROL METHOD FOR BIPED ROBOT TPYE TOY

abstract: A mobile robot system has a robot body attached to a mobile base. The robot body has a torso, a first robotic arm mechanically coupled to the torso, a first robotic leg, and a second robotic leg. The first robotic leg and the second robotic leg are controllably actuatable to enable the robot body to execute bipedal walking. The mobile base has a platform to receive a lower end of the first robotic leg and a lower end of the second robotic leg, at least one wheel and a controllable steering mechanism to enable the mobile base to travel both while the robot body is positioned on the platform and while the robot body is not positioned on the platform. The mobile base also has a plurality of components, at least one of which operable to support at least one function of the robot body.
source_title: SYSTEMS, DEVICES, AND METHODS FOR A MOBILE ROBOT SYSTEM

abstract: As a double-arm shoulder joint mechanism of a double-arm robot and a both-legs hip joint mechanism of a biped-walk robot, use is made of a double spherical joint having a construction such that joint rotation axes of 6 DOF are intersected at one point. As the double-arm shoulder joint mechanism of the double-arm robot, arms are connected respectively to a first spherical joint and a second spherical joint of the double spherical joint. As the both-legs hip joint mechanism of the biped-walk robot, legs are connected respectively to the first spherical joint and the second spherical joint of the double spherical joint. <IMAGE>
source_title: Two arm shoulder joint mechanism of two arm robot and two leg hip joint mechanism of two leg walking robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a wheel type biped robot which comprises a trunk, the upper end of the trunk is rotationally connected with a head, the two sides of the trunk are rotationally connected with arms, the lower end of the trunk is provided with a crotch, and the two ends of the crotch are connected with legs; a vital sign detection radar in telecommunication connection with the medical service system is arranged in the head; each arm comprises a connecting arm, a large arm connecting rod, a small arm connecting rod and a manipulator which are connected in sequence, one end of the connecting arm is connected with the trunk, the other end of the connecting arm is rotationally connected with the large arm connecting rod, the large arm connecting rod is rotationally connected with the small arm connecting rod, and the small arm connecting rod is rotationally connected with the manipulator; each leg part comprises a thigh and a shank which are hinged to each other, the other end of each thigh is rotationally connected with the crotch part, and the other end of each shank is connected with a roller. The invention relates to a household service robot with a medical service function.
source_title: Wheel type biped robot

abstract: The robot comprises a head (10), a body (20), a right arm (30), a left arm (40), a right leg (60) and a left leg (70), the right arm (30) and the left arm (40) are located on the two sides of the body (20) and symmetrical to each other, the right leg (60) and the left leg (70) are located at the lower end of the body (20) and symmetrical to each other, and a plurality of steering engines are arranged in the body (20) and used for controlling the arms, the legs and the head to rotate; the lower end of the body (20) is further provided with a skirt armor structural part, the robot can walk with two feet vertically under the driving of a plurality of steering engines, and the robot can automatically execute work. Actions can be carried out according to given programs, and actions and dialogues can be carried out according to voice instructions issued by people through man-machine interaction; based on an action algorithm, the activity is very flexible; a plurality of ingenious mechanical structures are designed on the body of the skyscraper, so that the skyscraper in a movie transformer 7 is restored to the greatest extent.
source_title: Robot

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot with quick-change hands and a motion analysis method thereof under special working conditions. The biped robot comprises a trunk unit, arm units, hip joint units and leg units. The arm unit is provided with manipulators through a quick change structure, and the manipulators comprise a clamping manipulator, a scissor manipulator and a screwing and locking manipulator. Module design is adopted for all movable joints of the robot, and integration and modularization of the robot are greatly improved; a connecting rod mechanism is adopted on the rear side of the knee joint, the design that the hinge point moves outwards is adopted, the motion dead point of the knee joint deviates, the joint module can apply acting force more smoothly, and meanwhile the complexity of the joint connecting position can be reduced.
source_title: Biped robot with quick-change hand and motion analysis method thereof under special working conditions

abstract: A double-leg and double-wheel composite motion robot comprises a trunk part, two mechanical legs and two mechanical arms, wherein the trunk part comprises a trunk and a crotch, the trunk and the crotch are connected through a rotary joint, and a trunk-crotch hydraulic cylinder is connected between the trunk and the crotch; the two mechanical legs are arranged on the two sides of the crotch, each mechanical leg is connected with the crotch through a rotary joint, and a driving wheel is installed at the bottom end of each mechanical leg; and the two mechanical arms are arranged on the two sidesof the trunk and connected with the trunk through rotary joints. The robot has the vertical walking and jumping capacity of a biped robot and the high moving speed of a wheeled robot. Meanwhile, the mechanical arms can achieve the functions of grabbing, carrying and the like; when the robot walks on a flat road surface, the robot can be driven by the driving wheels to move, the advancing speed isincreased, and the energy utilization efficiency is improved; when the robot needs to cross obstacles, the robot can play the advantages of a biped motion mode, and the functions of jumping, squatting, landing buffering and the like are achieved.
source_title: Double-leg and double-wheel composite motion robot

abstract: The invention relates to a biped bionic robot dynamics modeling method and device and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: abstracting a biped bionic robot into a multi-link rigid body system comprising a trunk, a right thigh, a right shank, a left thigh, a left shank, a right upper arm, a right small arm, a left upper arm and a left small arm; establishing a coordinate system by taking the tail end of the supporting leg as an original point, and constructing a dynamic model of each subsystem and a constraint relationship between the subsystems when the single-leg supporting phase and the double-leg supporting phase are carried out; and according to the constructed dynamic model of each subsystem and the constraint relationship among the subsystems, a constraint dynamic system is constructed in a hierarchical manner based on a UK equation, and a complete dynamic model of the biped bionic robot is obtained. The method has the advantages of being simple in implementation method, small in calculation amount, high in modeling efficiency and precision and the like.
source_title: Biped bionic robot dynamics modeling method and device and medium
